OPEN.name: Open
OPEN.definition: Open-dated, which indicates that the date has not been established.

UKWN.name: Unknown
UKWN.definition: Date is unknown by the sender or has not been established.

ONGO.name: Ongoing
ONGO.definition: Ongoing basis, which indicates that the date is determined by "ongoing basis" process, for example "au fil de l'eau".
